DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (CLL).

The combination of significant weight loss, B-symptoms (fatigue), palpable lymphadenopathy, splenomegaly, and flow cytometry showing monoclonal B lymphocytes is diagnostic for CLL. No further diagnostic tests are required at this time.
